name: Priya
source:
LIKES: Shopping sprees 
DISLIKES: Pineapples

Priya is an energetic young woman with a knack for thrifty shopping. She is quick to laugh and tries her best to remain calm in dangerous situations.

She seems to have had some financial success recently, but won't give you all the details. Despite this, she is still very reserved about spending money.

Priya was born in Mumbai, India. She finished school with good grades, but never really felt satisfied with where her life was heading. She didn't have a clear goal of what she wanted to do.

She picked up a part-time job after graduating, but found that most of her money went to providing for her family - and she rarely had a dime to spend on her own interests and hobbies.

However, once you get to know her, you feel like she somehow has more money than she knows what to do with. She boasts about her amazing seasonal wardrobes and latest shoes... So, you can't help but wonder how she suddenly came into wealth.
